description: Use after setting notify_phones to send one test text to each of the project's numbers through the team's Twilio account. Returns per-number results with Twilio's error when one fails. Fails if the team has no Twilio account (update_account sms) or the project has no notify_phones. A successful result means Twilio accepted it; ask the human to confirm it arrived, since unregistered US senders are filtered by carriers after Twilio accepts. Error codes and fixes are in furrow://docs/text-alerts. Do not use this to test email or the webhook — call test_webhook for the webhook.

project_id.description: Project (website) id from list_projects, create_project, or bootstrap_site.
